# DevExpress.Win.Printing NuGet Package

Contains classes that render, print, and export content from DevExpress data presentation controls. Visit DevExpress.com for additional information: [WinForms Printing and Data Export](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/printing/).

## Key Features

* Core functionality for built-in printing and export.

* Print preview: built-in preview form, page navigation, document scaling and zoom, page setup dialog, multi-page layout, watermarks and background colors, customizable margins, headers and footers, and ribbon or standard toolbars.

* Data Export: PDF, HTML, MHT, TEXT/RTF, CSV, XLS/XLSX, BMP/EMF/WMF/GIF/JPEG/PNG/TIFF.

* Printed version appearance modification.
